title: Research Speedrun: Clinical Prediction Pipeline
summary: A modular machine learning pipeline that processes MIMIC-III/MIMIC-IV clinical data through outlier handling, imputation, smoothing, and class balancing before training CatBoost and XGBoost models to predict clinical outcomes. Its Generators/Generator.py module imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer to oversample minority classes for balancing, instantiating and training CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers directly.
